verses.gurmukhi: ੧੦ : ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਿੰਦੀ ਮਤ ਮਤਾਂਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ
verses.translit_en: 10 : gursikh hi(n)dhee mat mataa(n)traa(n) to(n) u'chaa

en.bdb: Gursikh is above all religions and sects
There are six schools of philosophy and fourteen lineages (of the Sufis).
Householders, riders and foot soldiers move about in circles in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਦਸ ਨਾਮ ਧਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਾਦ ਕਵਾਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)niaasee dhas naam dhar kar vaadh kavaadhe|

en.bdb: Maintaining ten names, the sanyasi sects go on debating among themselves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਲ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਕਰਿ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਉਦਮਾਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: raaval baareh pa(n)th kar firadhe udhamaadhe|

en.bdb: Ravals, the yogis, also split in twelve sects and roam mad with pride.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਨੀ ਜੂਠ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੂਠੇ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: jainee jooTh na utarai jooThe parasaadhe|

en.bdb: Leftover is grace for Jains and their contamination is never removed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh rom na pujanee dhur aadh jugaadhe ||10||

en.bdb: They all are not equal to one trichome of that Gursikh who has attuned himself with that great primeval Lord.
